title: Pin @voidbrain/bricks and adopt its tokens with an FPVBuddy theme
goal: FPVBuddy takes bricks' tokens and foundations; its dark palette and local fonts are a theme and Tailwind utilities read bricks tokens
acceptance: An FPVBuddy theme sets bricks semantic tokens to today's palette, fonts (local woff2) and radii; Tailwind @theme maps its colour, font and radius names to bricks tokens instead of literals
Screens look unchanged: before/after screenshots of the batteries page in the PR; offline build still has no CDN link
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
A bricks component that cannot take FPVBuddy's look through the theme goes to bricks as a proposal, never a local override

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: about 45 colour tokens to map to fewer semantic ones, plus Tailwind wiring. Not a measurement.
